newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug private machinery orders fall 11.1% m/m.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug private machinery orders fall 11.1% m/m.

text.p: Japan's private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 11.1 percent in August from the previous month to 1.05 trillion yen, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Tuesday.
